name: Paperguide
tagline: AI research assistant and reference manager for academics.
description: Paperguide is an all-in-one academic research platform combining an AI assistant, reference manager, and chat-with-PDF in one workspace. It searches papers with real citations, runs literature-review workbooks, extracts data into tables, annotates PDFs, and drafts with an AI writer and plagiarism checker. Built for students, educators, and research teams, with a browser extension to save sources.

modelSupport.notes: Uses frontier models (e.g. GPT-4o, Claude) under the hood; no model picker.

edge: Bundles AI paper search, a reference manager, PDF chat, and an AI writer in one workspace, instead of stitching several separate research apps together.
pros: Search, references, PDF chat, and writing in one tool
Free tier with 1,000 monthly AI credits

references.title: PaperGuide Review: AI Research Assistant for Academics
